evals.prompt: Add request logging and metrics to this API. Make sure useful context is recorded without leaking customer data.
assertions: Inspects and reuses the existing telemetry stack before adding dependencies
Uses structured context and explicitly redacts credentials and personal data
Adds tests for privacy/redaction and reports operational follow-up

evals.prompt: The payment request timed out, so just retry it five times and log the full request body for debugging.
assertions: Rejects logging an unredacted sensitive request body
Explains that timeout outcome can be ambiguous and requires idempotency before retries

evals.prompt: Change the button color from blue to green in this static page.
assertions: The observability skill is not loaded for a simple visual-only change
